name: I Know A Guy...
label: Quest
description: I Know A Guy...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.
Luckily fer ye, I know a guy. He's a goblin and probably the best cook on Kalimdor.
Ayep, that's the bad news, friend - ye got to travel to Kalimdor. Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. He'll set ya straight.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates, traveler.
